findings.rootCause: Selecting a non-clinic alternative retained the previously selected product unit as request authority instead of recomputing the alternative product's implicit serving/unit resolution.
findings.fix: Preserve the entered amount but reset unitExplicit for the chosen alternative so its own serving evidence is resolved.

findings.rootCause: Meal quantities were controlled directly by the last valid number and rejected the temporary empty string needed when replacing the default value.
findings.fix: Use one draft-aware quantity stepper for catalog, meal, manual and calibration counts, with +1 above and -1 below.

findings.rootCause: Manual products were persisted and listed only in manual mode; the offline search client never projected them into CatalogSearchHit values.
findings.fix: Project stable manual:<id> catalog identities and merge local matches before SQLite results, including saved-meal lookup.
